content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist II (Medical)
content_sections.text: This recruitment is conducted under an ICMR funded project titled "Collaborative network of public institutions for early identification of Retinoblastoma and other ocular disorders presenting with leukocoria in children- An implementation model" at Dr. R.P. Centre, AIIMS, New Delhi. Applications are invited for the temporary/contractual post under this project.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notification details a single vacancy for the project post.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the specific educational and professional requirements prescribed for the position.

rows.essential_qualification: 1. MBBS + Post Graduate Degree (MD/MS/MPH) or any equivalent degree, including integrated PG degrees. OR 2. MBBS with PhD. OR 3. MBBS with three years' post qualification experience.
rows.desirable_qualification: Post graduate Degree/ Diploma in Ophthalmology / Community Medicine/ Community Ophthalmology

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist II (Medical)
content_sections.text: Prepare your CV, experience certificates, copy of age proof, and educational qualifications. Submit your application along with these documents by email to [email protected] . Ensure the application is submitted by the last date of 23 December 2026 up to 4:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. There is no provision of TA/DA for the interview. The Competent Authority reserves the right to modify/cancel the recruitment partially or completely, or to modify/revise/relax the criteria as per requirements of the project.
